description: Every example in guides and moduledocs runs: extend the docs example test (test/language_doc_examples_test.exs) to all extras, doctests for API docs, both native and Elixir mode where it applies. mix docs --warnings-as-errors in ci (broken auto-links fail). A link check for relative links between extras and to source files. A check that every error code has a catalogue entry with example and rewrite (exists?) and every public function has a @doc. Done when a broken example, link or missing doc fails mix ci.
title: Keep the docs true: checks in CI
